scenarios.name: a started capture run declares its epoch and the session geometry; the channel state carries status and video
a start the session refuses reports no geometry and the error
the helper path: a new unannounced run, the drawn track, frames at the plan’s rate; a delivery announces it and a seen grants control
a delivery or seen of another run, off the helper path, or while not running counts for nothing
the stall watchdog: 216 ms before two deliveries, then max(3 × average, average + 150) of the last 30 intervals
leaving the helper path ends the run, withdraws control and switches the track back; the watchdog is cleared
taking the helper hold starts a fresh run on the same path
the viewer’s channel lost on the helper path starts a new run and releases input; on the capture path it only releases
a helper challenge goes to the phone with the current run; a malformed one is never forwarded
a grant signed for the current run is relayed, one for another run dropped
screen input reaches the session with the geometry’s generation; page input and a rejection are errors

trace.error: remote screen input was not applied
remote screen takes screen input only

scenarios.name: the session’s status, cursor, geometry and stop reach the sink and the channel
a frame-seen of a run, then the stall watchdog’s new run, then that run’s first delivery: control is granted for the seen run only
a delivery of the current run made before its stall watchdog fires clears it: the cleared watchdog starts no run
a frame-seen, then the session’s stop: control is granted before the stop, never after it
install and password requests reach the session
